Summary Description: Dr. Shangqing Zhao's research portfolio spans quantum machine learning security, wireless privacy, RFID physical-layer vulnerabilities, perception-aware adversarial attacks in audio, and geolocation privacy. His work in quantum ML analyzes performance and security implications of QSVM, VQA, and QCNN models on real-world biomedical data, while his security-focused research explores proactive deception-based defenses against CSI-based inferences and crowd counting (HoneyBreath, Ghost). He investigates active RFID attacks (IDO) and practical reader-side defenses using STO/CSI fingerprinting, and leads studies on LLT-based geolocation attacks with corresponding defenses and privacy considerations. Across these domains, Zhao emphasizes rigorous real-world evaluation, cross-disciplinary collaboration, and the design of practical, scalable defenses aligned with contemporary AI and security challenges.
